description: Microsoft Advertising’s KEYWORD PLANNER — real monthly search volume, competition, suggested bid and ad impression share, expanded from seed keywords, a landing-page URL to mine, or a category. Run it BEFORE choosing keywords for a Microsoft campaign. locationIds is REQUIRED and deliberately not defaulted: a search volume with no market attached is a number nobody can act on, and inventing a country would silently answer about the wrong market — use microsoft_ads_geo_search to resolve a country or city name to an id, free. SAY THIS WHEN REPORTING: Competition is Microsoft’s Low/Medium/High bucket, NOT a percentage; MonthlySearchCounts is a per-month series rather than one number; SuggestedBid is in the account currency. An empty result means Microsoft found no ideas for those seeds, never that nobody searches for them. Read-only, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

attributes.description: which idea attributes to return — omit for all

categoryId.description: Microsoft keyword category id to mine ideas from

expandIdeas.description: false = do not expand; then keywords[] is mandatory

locationIds.description: REQUIRED — Microsoft location ids (microsoft_ads_geo_search resolves names to ids, free)

maxSearchVolume.description: only ideas with at most this many monthly searches

minSearchVolume.description: only ideas with at least this many monthly searches

network.description: search network the volume is measured on: Microsoft-owned, partner-syndicated or both

url.description: a landing page for Microsoft to mine ideas from

name: microsoft_ads_keyword_ideas
title: Microsoft Advertising keyword planner
